title: sdm-dossier: the stac-sdm 1.1 fields of a species distribution model product
description: The sdm: fields proposed for stac-sdm 1.1 (atlas/pipeline/docs/stac-sdm-proposal.md) on top of the 1.0.0 fields (https://marinesensitivity.github.io/stac-sdm/v1.0.0/schema.json): the richness and uncertainty response types, the taxa and the aggregation of a multi-species product, the model evaluation and the response curves. On an Item (type Feature) the fields are in properties; on a Collection they are at the top level. The 1.0.0 fields are typed loosely, as producers use them today. Written by the atlas pipeline and workflows/R; read by the atlas species dossier. STAC core is out of scope: only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through. Reader checks this schema cannot express: sdm:evaluation.roc fpr and tpr have equal length; a response curve's x, y and density have equal length.

then.description: an Item carries the sdm: fields in properties

properties.description: the Item properties, holding the sdm: fields

authorities.description: cross-references to taxonomic authorities by their native identifier

botw.description: the BirdLife (Birds of the World) id

gbif.description: the GBIF taxon key (as in 1.0.0 sdm:taxon)

iucn.description: the IUCN Red List taxon id (as in 1.0.0 sdm:taxon)

fields.description: the sdm: fields; the four 1.0.0 core descriptors are required, sdm:taxon and sdm:taxa exclude each other

not.description: sdm:taxon (one taxon) and sdm:taxa (a multi-species product) are mutually exclusive

sdm:response_type.description: what the per-cell value represents: the 1.0.0 values plus richness (number of taxa, or a ratio of it) and uncertainty (the spread of a derived or modelled quantity)

sdm:method.description: the modelling approach (open vocabulary: env_envelope, density_surface_model, derived_merge ...)

sdm:method_detail.description: free-text detail of the algorithm settings or the merge rule

sdm:source_authority.description: the originating authority (AquaMaps, NOAA SWFSC, MBON BioTrack ...)

sdm:temporal_interval.description: the granularity of the prediction interval (static, monthly, seasonal in 1.0.0); a string here

sdm:predictors.description: the environmental predictors of the model

sdm:value_unit.description: the unit of the per-cell value (percent, animals/km2, species, unitless ...)

sdm:value_range.description: the nominal [min, max] domain of the value

sdm:taxon.description: the one taxon a single-species product predicts (1.0.0). group is a string in the atlas pipeline and a boolean in the MST manifest, so both pass; other keys pass through.

authorities.description: the authority ids (worms, botw, itis, gbif, iucn)

group.description: the coarse group (fish, bird ...): a string, or a boolean in the MST manifest

sdm:taxa.description: the taxa contributing to a multi-species product

group.description: the coarse group (as in sdm:taxon; the proposal's example carries it)

sdm:aggregation.description: how a multi-species value was formed

of.description: what was aggregated (e.g. per-species occupancy probability)

n.description: the number of inputs aggregated (e.g. taxa)

sdm:evaluation.description: how well the model fits: named metrics, the ROC curve and notes

metrics.description: the evaluation metrics, at least one

partition.description: the data it was computed on

roc.description: the ROC curve; fpr and tpr have equal length (a reader check)

tpr.description: true positive rates, one per fpr

sdm:response_curves.description: the partial response of the prediction to each predictor; x, y and density have equal length (a reader check)

density.description: the share of the records (or cells) at each x, for a rug or a shaded band
